name: @pipeworx/mcp-geoboundaries

tools.name: get_boundaries
tools.description: Get administrative boundary metadata for a country from geoBoundaries: unit count, year represented, source, license, and download URLs for full GeoJSON (gjDownloadURL), simplified GeoJSON (simplifiedGeometryGeoJSON), TopoJSON (tjDownloadURL) and a static zip. ISO3 is the 3-letter country code (USA, FRA, KEN, IND). ADM level: ADM0=country, ADM1=state/province, ADM2=county/district, ADM3/ADM4=finer, ALL=every level. Default product gbOpen is CC-BY.

adm.description: Admin level: ADM0=country, ADM1=state/province, ADM2=county/district, ADM3, ADM4, or ALL.

product.description: Boundary product. gbOpen (default, CC-BY) | gbHumanitarian | gbAuthoritative.

tools.name: get_geometry
tools.description: Fetch the actual simplified GeoJSON FeatureCollection geometry for a country/ADM level from geoBoundaries. WARNING: geometry payloads are large (a simplified national ADM1 set can be several MB); this only returns the simplified geometry and refuses payloads over ~4 MB — for those use get_boundaries and download the URL directly. Prefer get_boundaries unless you explicitly need the coordinates. Not valid for adm="ALL".

adm.description: Admin level (single level only; "ALL" is not supported here).

product.description: Boundary product. gbOpen (default, CC-BY) | gbHumanitarian | gbAuthoritative.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-geoboundaries forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the geoboundaries pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
